summary: The diff adds some frontend leaderboard tab/query wiring and date-range utilities, plus a migration scaffold and several unrelated availability/UI features. However, the core backend changes required to store a timestamp derived from the user-selected result date and to filter weekly/monthly leaderboards by last-7/last-30 days based on that timestamp are not evidenced in the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update backend leaderboard timeframe filtering so weekly counts only results from last 7 days and monthly counts only results from last 30 days (inclusive), using the user-selected result date timestamps; returned totals must reflect only results in the selected timeframe; avoid inconsistent YYYYMMDD vs epoch comparisons; preserve ordering comparator.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not show any changes to the backend getLeaderboard implementation or any timeframe filtering logic. The backend state shown still uses dailyLogs keyed by (Principal, Int) day IDs and there is no visible timestamp-based filtering implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Store and use a discrete timestamp derived from the user-selected result date when recording wins/losses, and ensure decrement/remove operations still work with the new representation.
missing_requirements.reason: No new stored timestamp field or new data structure is shown for match results/daily logs. The types in backend/main.mo and backend/migration.mo show DailyLog with only wins/losses, and dailyLogs keyed by (Principal, Int) without any persisted timestamp derived from the selected day.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add necessary Motoko state migration for existing stored match results so upgrades preserve existing results and leaderboard queries do not trap after upgrade (only if required by state representation change).
missing_requirements.reason: A migration module is added, but it is explicitly a no-op with 'New types (same as old for current migration)' and does not migrate to any new state representation needed for timestamp-based filtering. Since the diff does not show a new stored representation, there is no evidence the required migration for that change exists.

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend leaderboard filters (Weekly/Monthly/All Time) must display rankings matching the corrected backend timeframe logic without changing the date selection and record/remove flow; timeframe label/range must remain coherent.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend tabs and query keying are present, and date utilities were added for timeframe windows, but there is no evidence in the diff summary that the backend timeframe logic was corrected. Without the backend fix, the frontend cannot reliably 'match the corrected backend timeframe logic' as required.
